  local second = deck.slice(cutPoint+1, deck.listLen())
  local first = deck.slice(1, cutPoint)
  local result = copyList(second)
  result.appendList(first)
  result
}

9584.answer:
func blendColors(color1, color2, t) = {
  local c1 = splitColor(color1)
  local c2 = splitColor(color2)
  local r = round(c1[2]*(1-t)+c2[2]*t)
  local g = round(c1[3]*(1-t)+c2[3]*t)
  local b = round(c1[4]*(1-t)+c2[4]*t)
  makeColor([r,g,b])
}

func dungeonAmbientColor(floor) = {
  local r = if (255 - floor*5 < 50) 50 else 255 - floor*5
  local g = if (238 - floor*8 < 20) 20 else 238 - floor*8
  local b = if (204 - floor*10 < 10) 10 else 204 - floor*10
  makeColor([r,g,b])
}
